title: Hibernate
description: This turn, your [gold]Frost[/gold] grants ALL allies [gold]Block[/gold].
smart_description: Duration-aware text: 'This turn' if 1 turn remains, else 'For the next [blue]N[/blue] turns'. Your [gold]Frost[/gold] grants ALL allies [gold]Block[/gold].
notes: This power doesn't directly affect the player — instead, Frost orbs check for its presence and modify their behavior accordingly. The power automatically decrements at the end of each player turn.
